verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a Management API for programmatically managing organizations and projects. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at supabase.com/openapi.json. Auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs are also reflected from the database schema, so both the platform and the data plane are API-drivable. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of authenticated Management API calls actually driving project operations, and detail on endpoint coverage, auth and rate limits in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Manage your Supabase organizations and projects programmatically.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://supabase.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Supabase APIs are generated from your database, which means that we can use database introspection to generate type-safe API definitions.
The Supabase GraphQL API is automatically reflected from your database's schema using pg_graphql.
